name: zeffect_set_conditional_effect_level
description: zEffect::SetConditionalEffectLevel stores the caller-provided effect level in the global conditional-effect level.
known_limits: tier S is not yet attempted for this leaf setter; tier C equivalence is accepted from current Binary Ninja store evidence plus direct native smoke coverage.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x45e0f0 is a fastcall ECX store to g_zEffect_ConditionalEffectLevel followed by return, with no callees or other side effects.
The native smoke verifies positive, zero, and negative level inputs are stored exactly in g_zEffect_ConditionalEffectLevel and restores the previous global state.
